en.headline: Police arrest Filipino domestic helper over alleged slapping of five-month-old baby in Ho Man Tin
en.dek: The father reported the case at Queen Elizabeth Hospital after reviewing home CCTV that showed the helper striking the infant three times in the early hours.
body: Police have arrested a 40-year-old Filipino domestic helper on suspicion of abusing or neglecting a child after a five-month-old baby girl was allegedly slapped in a Ho Man Tin flat.

The father reported the incident at about 10.43am on Sunday at Queen Elizabeth Hospital. He told officers he had reviewed home CCTV and seen the helper slap the infant three times between roughly 2am and 4am at a flat on Chung Hau Street. The baby was taken for examination; no visible injuries were found.
The helper was arrested for an offence under the Offences Against the Person Ordinance relating to cruelty to a child in her care. The case is being handled by the Kowloon City District crime unit.

zh.headline: 何文田菲傭涉掌摑5個月大女嬰被捕 父親翻查閉路電視揭發
zh.dek: 父親今早在伊利沙伯醫院報案，指閉路電視顯示外傭凌晨兩至四時三次掌摑女嬰。
body: 何文田忠孝街一單位發生懷疑虐兒案，40歲菲籍家庭傭工被警方拘捕。
警方指今早約10時43分，女嬰父親在伊利沙伯醫院報案，表示翻查家中閉路電視後發現，外傭於凌晨兩時至四時期間三次掌摑五個月大女兒。女嬰經檢查無表面傷痕。
警方以涉嫌對所看管兒童虐待或忽略罪將該名外傭拘捕，案件由九龍城警區刑事調查隊跟進。
